int_name: N 8TH ST & CECIL B MOORE AVE

result.summary: The environment features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a signalized intersection, but the markings are significantly faded. The industrial-commercial setting and wide roadway suggest a focus on vehicle throughput over pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk markings are heavily worn and barely visible, reducing driver awareness of the crossing zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground across the side street

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signal Heads
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walk/don't-walk signals are visible at the signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the left

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental-style high-visibility markings to improve the visibility of the pedestrian crossing to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including a sidewalk and a signalized crossing, though the environment is degraded. result.summary: The environment features a wide two-lane roadway with sidewalks and a signalized intersection. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like signals and marked crosswalks are present, the markings are faded and the wide street layout may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The wide, undivided roadway without traffic calming measures may encourage higher vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Main roadway stretching into the distance

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.
